llms.body:
# Intuit

> Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for
> consumers, small businesses, and the self-employed with TurboTax, Credit Karma,
> QuickBooks, Mailchimp, and Intuit Enterprise Suite.

Founded in 1983 by Scott Cook and Tom Proulx, Intuit Inc. is headquartered at
2700 Coast Avenue, Mountain View, California (Nasdaq: INTU). Sasan Goodarzi
serves as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. Intuit's strategy is to operate
as an AI-driven expert platform, connecting customers to AI agents and
AI-enabled human tax and financial experts to automate everyday financial
tasks and deliver done-for-you experiences. This file covers the corporate
intuit.com site; individual products maintain their own llms.txt files.

## Products

- [Products Overview](https://www.intuit.com/products/): Overview of Intuit's product portfolio
- [Intuit Business Credit Card](https://www.intuit.com/credit-card/): No-annual-fee business credit card that syncs with QuickBooks, issued by WebBank
- [Intuit Assist](https://www.intuit.com/intuitassist/): Intuit's generative AI financial assistant across its products
- [For Accountants](https://www.intuit.com/accountants/): Professional tax and accounting products and resources

## AI & Technology

- [AI Research](https://www.intuit.com/ai/research/): Intuit's applied AI research organization
- [AI Research Publications](https://www.intuit.com/ai/research/publications/): Published papers from Intuit's AI research teams
- [Technology](https://www.intuit.com/technology/): How Intuit builds and operates its technology platform
- [Strategy](https://www.intuit.com/strategy/): Intuit's corporate strategy and big bets
- [Intuit + Anthropic](https://www.intuit.com/anthropic/): Intuit's collaboration with Anthropic
- [Intuit on ChatGPT](https://www.intuit.com/chatgpt/): Intuit's apps and presence in ChatGPT

## Company

- [Company Overview](https://www.intuit.com/company/): Corporate overview, mission, and leadership
- [Executives](https://www.intuit.com/company/executives/): Intuit's executive leadership team
- [Sasan Goodarzi](https://www.intuit.com/company/executives/sasan-goodarzi/): Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
- [Origins](https://www.intuit.com/company/origins/): The founding and history of Intuit
- [Operating Values](https://www.intuit.com/company/operating-values/): Intuit's core operating values
- [Locations](https://www.intuit.com/company/locations/): Intuit's global office locations
- [Press Room](https://www.intuit.com/company/press-room/): News, announcements, and media resources
- [Contact](https://www.intuit.com/company/contact/): How to reach Intuit
- [Intuit Dome] (https://www.intuit.com/intuitdome/): Intuit Dome naming partnership
- [Supplier Partner Programs] (https://www.intuit.com/company/supplier-programs/): Partner supplier information

## Careers

- [Careers](https://www.intuit.com/careers/): Open roles and working at Intuit
- [Expert Careers](https://www.intuit.com/expert-careers/): Remote tax preparer and bookkeeper roles in Intuit's expert network
- [Military](https://www.intuit.com/military/): Career and hiring programs for veterans and military families

## Corporate Responsibility & Education

- [Corporate Responsibility](https://www.intuit.com/company/corporate-responsibility/): Intuit's social impact and citizenship programs
- [Corporate Responsibility Report](https://www.intuit.com/company/corporate-responsibility/report/): Annual corporate responsibility reporting
- [Sustainability](https://www.intuit.com/company/corporate-responsibility/sustainability/): Climate and environmental commitments
- [Diversity](https://www.intuit.com/company/diversity/): Intuit's approach to diversity and inclusion
- [Financial Literacy](https://www.intuit.com/financial-literacy/): Free financial education resources
- [Intuit for Education](https://www.intuit.com/solutions/education/): Free financial literacy curriculum and program for schools and students

## Partners & Ventures

- [Partners](https://www.intuit.com/partners/): Developer and app partner ecosystem
- [Intuit Ventures](https://www.intuit.com/ventures/): Intuit's strategic investment arm
- [Intuit Connect](https://www.intuit.com/intuitconnect/): Intuit's flagship conference for accounting and finance professionals
- [Intuit for Startups (Israel)](https://www.intuit.com/intuit-for-startups/israel/): Intuit's startup engagement program in Israel

## Other Intuit Products

- [TurboTax](https://turbotax.intuit.com/): Consumer tax preparation software and filing
- [QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/): Accounting, payments, payroll, and capital for small and mid-market businesses
- [Credit Karma](https://www.creditkarma.com/): Free credit monitoring and personal finance tools
- [Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/): Email marketing and marketing automation
- [Intuit Blog](https://www.intuit.com/blog/): Company news and perspectives on financial AI, money, careers, and the tax industry
- [Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/): Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software for mid-market 

## Optional

- [Accessibility](https://www.intuit.com/accessibility/): Intuit's accessibility commitment
- [Support](https://www.intuit.com/support/): Product support directory
- [Legal](https://www.intuit.com/legal/): Terms and legal policies
- [Privacy](https://www.intuit.com/privacy/): Privacy policy and data practices
- [Investor Relations](https://investors.intuit.com/): Financial results, SEC filings, and investor news
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/intuit)
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/intuit)
- [X (Twitter)](https://twitter.com/Intuit)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/intuit)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/Intuit)
